rect_intersect(x, y, width, height, l_x, l_y) {let r_x = (x + width/2);let r_y = (y + height/2);let dx = l_x - r_x;let dy = l_y - r_y;let θ = Math.abs(dy / dx);let φ = height / width;if (θ > φ) {return [r_x + ((height/2)/θ)*Math.sign(dx),r_y + (height/2)*Math.sign(dy),];} else {return [r_x + (width/2)*Math.sign(dx),r_y + ((width/2)*θ)*Math.sign(dy),];}}function draw_unfocus() {for (let b of document.querySelectorAll(".tile")) {b.setAttribute("fill-opacity", 0.5);}}function draw_focus(a) {a.setAttribute("fill-opacity", 1);a.parentElement.appendChild(a);}function draw_arrow(a, b) {if (b == a) {return;}let svg = document.documentElement;let ns = svg.getAttribute("xmlns");let a_x = parseInt(a.dataset.x);let a_y = parseInt(a.dataset.y);let a_width = parseInt(a.dataset.width);let a_height = parseInt(a.dataset.height);let b_x = parseInt(b.dataset.x);let b_y = parseInt(b.dataset.y);let b_width = parseInt(b.dataset.width);let b_height = parseInt(b.dataset.height);let [a_ix, a_iy] = rect_intersect(a_x, a_y, a_width, a_height,b_x + b_width/2, b_y + b_height/2);let [b_ix, b_iy] = rect_intersect(b_x, b_y, b_width, b_height,a_x + a_width/2, a_y + a_height/2);let arrow = document.createElementNS(ns, "line");arrow.classList.add("arrow");arrow.setAttribute("x1", a_ix);arrow.setAttribute("y1", a_iy);arrow.setAttribute("x2", b_ix);arrow.setAttribute("y2", b_iy);arrow.setAttribute("stroke", "#000000");arrow.setAttribute("marker-end", "url(#arrowhead)");arrow.setAttribute("pointer-events", "none");a.parentElement.appendChild(arrow);}function draw_callgraph(a) {let seen = {};let recurse = function(a) {if (a.dataset.name in seen) {return;}seen[a.dataset.name] = true;for (let child of children[a.dataset.name] || []) {let b = document.getElementById("c-"+child);if (b) {draw_arrow(a, b);recurse(b);}}};recurse(a);seen = {};recurse = function(a) {if (a.dataset.name in seen) {return;}seen[a.dataset.name] = true;for (let child of children[a.dataset.name] || []) {let b = document.getElementById("c-"+child);if (b) {draw_focus(b);recurse(b);}}};recurse(a);draw_focus(a);}function draw_deepest(a) {let seen = {};let recurse = function(a) {if (a.dataset.name in seen) {return;}seen[a.dataset.name] = true;if (children[a.dataset.name]) {if (children[a.dataset.name][0] in seen) {let child = children[a.dataset.name][0];let b = document.getElementById("c-"+child);if (b) {draw_arrow(a, b);}}let child = children[a.dataset.name].find((child) => !(child in seen));if (child) {let b = document.getElementById("c-"+child);if (b) {draw_arrow(a, b);recurse(b);}}}};recurse(a);seen = {};recurse = function(a) {if (a.dataset.name in seen) {return;}seen[a.dataset.name] = true;if (children[a.dataset.name]) {let child = children[a.dataset.name].find((child) => !(child in seen));if (child) {let b = document.getElementById("c-"+child);if (b) {draw_focus(b);recurse(b);}}}};recurse(a);draw_focus(a);}function draw_callees(a) {for (let child of children[a.dataset.name] || []) {let b = document.getElementById("c-"+child);if (b) {draw_arrow(a, b);}}for (let child of children[a.dataset.name] || []) {let b = document.getElementById("c-"+child);if (b) {draw_focus(b);}}draw_focus(a);}function draw_callers(a) {for (let parent in children) {if ((children[parent] || []).includes(a.dataset.name)) {let b = document.getElementById("c-"+parent);if (b) {draw_arrow(b, a);}}}for (let parent in children) {if ((children[parent] || []).includes(a.dataset.name)) {let b = document.getElementById("c-"+parent);if (b) {draw_focus(b);}}}draw_focus(a);}function undraw() {for (let arrow of document.querySelectorAll(".arrow")) {arrow.remove();}for (let b of document.querySelectorAll(".tile")) {b.setAttribute("fill-opacity", 1);}}function switch_stack(name) {for (let b of document.querySelectorAll(".stack")) {b.setAttribute("visibility", "hidden");}let s = document.getElementById("s-"+name);if (s) {s.setAttribute("visibility", "visible");for (let b of s.querySelectorAll(".frame,.ctx")) {draw_focus(b);}}}function draw_stack(a) {if (!a) {let s = document.querySelector(".stack[visibility=\"visible\"]");for (let b of s.querySelectorAll(".frame,.ctx")) {draw_focus(b);}return;}let c = document.getElementById("c-"+(a.classList.contains("ctx")? a.dataset.func: a.dataset.name));if (c) {draw_deepest(c);}let y = parseInt(a.dataset.y);for (b of a.parentElement.querySelectorAll(".frame,.ctx")) {if (parseInt(b.dataset.y) >= y) {draw_focus(b);}}draw_focus(a);}const modes = [{name: "callgraph", draw: draw_callgraph},{name: "deepest", draw: draw_deepest },{name: "callees", draw: draw_callees },{name: "callers", draw: draw_callers },];let state = 0;let hovered = null;let active_code = null;let active_stack = null;let paused = false;function enter_tile(a, event) {hovered = a;if (paused) {return;}if (a.classList.contains("code")) {if (!active_code && !active_stack) {undraw();draw_unfocus();modes[state].draw(a);switch_stack(a.dataset.name);}} else if (a.classList.contains("frame") || a.classList.contains("ctx")) {if (!active_stack) {undraw();draw_unfocus();draw_stack(a);}}}function leave_tile(a, event) {hovered = null;if (paused) {return;}if (!active_stack) {undraw();if (!active_code) {switch_stack("lfs2_stat");} else {draw_unfocus();modes[state].draw(active_code);draw_stack();}}}function draw_mode() {let mode = document.getElementById("mode");if (mode) {mode.textContent = "mode: "+ modes[state].name+ ((paused) ? " (paused)": (active_code || active_stack)? " (frozen)": "");}}function redraw() {undraw();if (active_stack) {draw_unfocus();draw_stack(active_stack);} else if (active_code) {draw_unfocus();modes[state].draw(active_code);draw_stack();} else if (hovered) {enter_tile(hovered);}}function click_header(a, event) {if (paused) {return;}state = (state + 1) % modes.length;draw_mode();redraw();}let prev_code = null;let prev_stack = null;function click_tile(a, event) {if (paused) {return;}if (event && event.detail == 2 && ((!prev_code && !prev_stack)|| (a == prev_code && !prev_stack)|| a == prev_stack)) {active_code = prev_code;active_stack = prev_stack;if (a.classList.contains("code")) {click_header();}return;}prev_code = active_code;prev_stack = active_stack;if (a.classList.contains("code")) {if (a == active_code && !active_stack) {active_code = null;} else {active_code = null;active_stack = null;enter_tile(a);active_code = a;}} else if (a.classList.contains("frame")|| a.classList.contains("ctx")) {if (a == active_stack) {active_stack = null;} else {active_stack = null;enter_tile(a);active_stack = a;}}draw_mode();}function keydown(event) {if (event.key == "m") {click_header();} else if (event.key == "Escape"|| event.key == "e") {active_code = null;active_stack = null;if (paused) {keydown({key: "Pause"});}draw_mode();redraw();} else if (event.key == "Pause"|| event.key == "p") {paused = !paused;draw_mode();if (paused) {for (let e of document.querySelectorAll("[style*=\"user-select\"]")) {e.style["user-select"] = "auto";}for (let e of document.querySelectorAll("[cursor]")) {e.setAttribute("cursor", "auto");}} else {document.getSelection().empty();for (let e of document.querySelectorAll("[style*=\"user-select\"]")) {e.style["user-select"] = "none";}for (let e of document.querySelectorAll("[cursor]")) {e.setAttribute("cursor", "pointer");}}}}window.addEventListener("keydown", keydown);
